**UI Audit Report: EaseUS Data Recovery Wizard Free (File Repair View)**

### 1. LAYOUT
*   **Window Bounds:** Maximised window, 1024x768 (standard desktop resolution).
*   **Title Bar (0, 0 to 1024, 45):** Contains app icon/title (left) and utility/window controls (right).
*   **Sidebar (0, 45 to 280, 942):** Vertical navigation pane with grouped sections.
    *   *Data Recovery Section:* Top group.
    *   *Advanced Features Section:* Middle group.
    *   *File Backup Section:* Bottom group.
*   **Main Content Area (280, 45 to 1024, 942):** White card/panel containing the primary task interface.
    *   *Header Region:* Title and subtitle text block.
    *   *Options List:* Three vertically stacked repair options (Icon + Text).
    *   *Illustration Area:* Right-aligned decorative graphic (Folder + Mascot).
    *   *Action Footer:* "Start" button anchored bottom-left of the content area.
*   **Taskbar (0, 942 to 1024, 768):** Windows 11 centered taskbar.

### 2. TEXT (Verbatim)
*   **Title Bar:** `EaseUS Data Recovery Wizard Free`
*   **Sidebar - Section Headers:**
    *   `Data Recovery` (Top)
    *   `Advanced Features` (Middle)
    *   `File Backup` (Bottom)
*   **Sidebar - Items:**
    *   `Hardware Disk`
    *   `SD Card`
    *   `More Recovery Tools`
    *   `File Repair` (Selected)
    *   `Lost Partition Rescue`
    *   `ChronoSnap Backup`
*   **Main Area:**
    *   Heading: `Repair Corrupted Videos, Photos and Documents`
    *   Subheading: `Add corrupted files to easily repair them.`
    *   Option 1: `Repair corrupted or unplayable videos`
    *   Option 2: `Repair damaged or partially missing photos`
    *   Option 3: `Repair damaged or cannot be opened documents` (Note: Text appears slightly truncated/cut off at the right edge in the screenshot).
    *   Button: `Start`

### 3. COLOR (Estimated Hex)
*   **Backgrounds:**
    *   Window Background (Sidebar): `#F5F7FA` (Light Blue-Grey)
    *   Main Content Surface: `#FFFFFF` (White)
    *   Sidebar Selection Highlight: `#E8F0FE` (Very Light Blue)
*   **Text:**
    *   Primary Text (Headings/Selected Item): `#1F2329` (Near Black)
    *   Secondary Text (Subheadings/Unselected Items): `#5F6B7A` (Dark Grey)
    *   Button Text: `#FFFFFF` (White)
*   **Accents & Borders:**
    *   Primary Brand Blue (Button/Icons): `#287DFA` (Vibrant Blue)
    *   Success Indicator (Checkmark): `#34C759` (Green)
    *   Selection Left Border: `#287DFA` (3-4px solid line)

### 4. TYPOGRAPHY
*   **Main Heading (`Repair Corrupted...`):** Sans-Serif (likely Segoe UI/Inter), ~24px, Weight 600 (Semi-Bold).
*   **Subheading (`Add corrupted...`):** Sans-Serif, ~14px, Weight 400 (Regular), Line height ~1.5.
*   **Option Labels (`Repair corrupted...`):** Sans-Serif, ~16px, Weight 500 (Medium).
*   **Sidebar Items:** Sans-Serif, ~13-14px, Weight 400 (Regular), Weight 600 when selected.
*   **Section Headers (`Data Recovery`):** Sans-Serif, ~12px, Weight 600, slightly lighter grey color.

### 5. SPACING & SIZING
*   **Sidebar Width:** ~280px.
*   **Content Padding:** ~40-50px from the edges of the white panel.
*   **List Item Spacing:** Vertical gap between repair options is approx 30-40px.
*   **Button Dimensions:** Width ~140px, Height ~44px. Border Radius: ~6px (slightly rounded corners).
*   **Icons (Sidebar/Options):** 24x24px or 32x32px grid.
*   **Illustration:** Occupies the right 40% of the content area, roughly 400x350px.

### 6. CONTROLS & STATES
*   **Sidebar List Item (`File Repair`):**
    *   **State:** Selected / Active.
    *   **Indicators:** Light blue background fill, blue left-border accent (3px), bold text color.
*   **Sidebar List Item (`Hardware Disk`):**
    *   **State:** Normal / Completed (inferred).
    *   **Indicators:** Green checkmark badge on the right side of the item.
*   **Repair Options (Videos/Photos/Documents):**
    *   **Type:** Clickable List Items / Radio-style selection (though no radio button is visible, they act as selectors). Currently in default state (none explicitly checked, or implicit selection pending 'Start').
*   **Primary Button (`Start`):**
    *   **Type:** Call to Action (CTA) Button.
    *   **State:** Normal (Enabled). Solid fill.
*   **Window Controls (Top Right):**
    *   Minimize, Maximize/Restore, Close buttons. Standard Windows chrome.

### 7. ICONOGRAPHY
*   **Style:** Flat, Outline & Filled hybrid (mostly filled shapes with simple details), "Friendly" corporate style.
*   **Sidebar Icons:**
    *   `Hardware Disk`: Hard drive icon (blue/grey).
    *   `SD Card`: SD card icon.
    *   `More Recovery Tools`: Wrench/Spanner + Magnifying glass.
    *   `File Repair`: Document with a wrench/tool (Blue, active state).
    *   `Lost Partition Rescue`: Life preserver ring.
    *   `ChronoSnap Backup`: Circular arrow (refresh/backup symbol).
*   **Option Icons:**
    *   Video: Film strip frame with a small 'tool' badge.
    *   Photo: Image/Landscape icon with a small 'tool' badge.
    *   Document: Text file icon with a small 'tool' badge.
*   **Mascot/Illustration:** A stylized robot character holding a puzzle piece, next to a translucent folder graphic.

### 8. STATE
*   **Page State:** **Initial / Idle**. The user has navigated to the "File Repair" module but has not yet initiated a scan or repair process. No loading spinners or progress bars are visible.
*   **Context:** The "Hardware Disk" item having a green checkmark suggests a previous action was completed successfully on that module. The main area is ready for user input (selecting a file type and clicking Start).
